owner_time_policy: Owner involvement is limited to platform-required account creation, identity/security verification, consent, cost approval, and exceptional reauthorization.
secret_storage_rule: Passwords, tokens, recovery codes, phone numbers, private email addresses, and client secrets must never be stored in this repository.

platforms.connection: OAuth 2.0 PKCE with offline access; persistent runtime authorization supported
owner_actions_remaining: Decide whether @oroknows remains the permanent EMRADAR identity or a dedicated EMRADAR account is required
Reauthorize only if the persisted authorization is revoked or a platform security challenge occurs
Approve an X API plan only after its AUD cost and limits are verified
autonomy_blockers: External scheduler and native SCAN_READY handoff are not yet proven end to end
Current policy requires exact owner publication review for each external asset

platforms.connection: Company Page plus approved Community Management application and organization posting authorization
owner_actions_remaining: Create or confirm the EMRADAR Company Page
Hold an administrator or content-administrator role
Complete LinkedIn developer application verification and access review
Authorize organization posting when the connector callback is ready

platforms.connection: User-authorized AT Protocol session stored only in the deployment secret store
owner_actions_remaining: Create and verify the EMRADAR account and handle
Authorize publishing when the connector is ready

platforms.connection: Meta developer application and user-authorized Threads publishing access
owner_actions_remaining: Create or confirm the Meta identity required for the EMRADAR Threads account
Complete platform verification or security checks
Approve the Meta developer application and authorize publishing when the connector is ready

platforms.connection: OAuth user authorization with write:statuses on the selected server
owner_actions_remaining: Select a suitable server and accept its rules
Create and verify the EMRADAR account
Authorize publishing when the connector is ready

platforms.connection: Authorized integration plus a maintained community allow-list and current rule snapshot
owner_actions_remaining: Create and verify the EMRADAR account
Authorize the integration when the connector is ready
Approve the initial community allow-list and its rule snapshots
platforms.hard_rule: Never publish merely to maximize coverage. A relevant community, current rule check, and route-specific review are mandatory; NO_RELEVANT_ROUTE is a successful outcome.
